methodology_note: Independent project validation rules. Findings require context and do not necessarily indicate source-data errors.

rule_results.interpretation: A station record lacks its identifier.
Multiple records share one station identifier. Investigate whether the service represents unique stations or multiple events.
The feature cannot be located using its geometry.
The geometry fails its structural validity test.
One or both UTM attributes are absent. This does not establish an incorrect station location.
Drilling depth is unrecorded. Determine whether this field applies to the station.
Completion date is unrecorded. Review applicability and source-system history.
County is absent. Compare the station location with an authoritative county boundary.
